patch.value: Work completed and released in 2026.6.13. Release attribution set explicitly so pm-changelog --respect-item-release files the entry under 2026.6.13 instead of the current release notes.
A closed item whose changelog entry appears under the 2026.6.13 heading it actually shipped in, leaving the current release notes untouched.
Item remained in_progress with no activity after its work shipped, so the delivery was absent from the changelog while still counting as open work in every fleet audit.

Retired as shipped: aligning pm-web with pm CLI 2026.6.12 release readiness was completed and released in 2026.6.13, but the item was never closed and sat in progress ever since, inflating every fleet audit.

Before this closeout the item had remained in_progress with no activity since its work shipped, so the delivery was missing from the changelog while still being counted as open work in every fleet audit. Closing it with an explicit release attribution is what added the historical entry.
